nightSimple.intro: Start with what you can see tonight.

guide.title: Starpath guide
guide.defaults: Start with an example, then enter your equipment’s actual specifications. Preset fields of view vary between models.
guide.choose: Enter values or pick an example
guide.optics: Exit pupil {{pupil}}mm · approx. stellar limit {{limit}} mag · Dawes limit {{dawes}} arcsec. A general upper reference for telescope power is {{max}}×. Conditions and equipment determine the useful limit.
guide.mountHelp: Clamp the phone where you can see its screen, with its top edge parallel to the tube and pointing toward the target. This uses the top edge, not the rear camera. Center a bright star in the eyepiece to align. Keep the phone and holder fixed afterward.
guide.sensorMethod: Starpath uses manual star alignment and a relative orientation sensor. It does not identify star patterns through the camera. Confirm the final position in your finder or eyepiece.
guide.safety: Never aim a telescope or binoculars at the Sun. Guidance near the Sun is blocked. Eclipse glasses do not replace a telescope solar filter.
guide.unaligned: Align to a bright star first
guide.sensorUnavailable: Relative orientation is unavailable. Check permissions. Field charts and star hopping also work without a sensor.
guide.alignHelp: Center this star in the eyepiece, then tap below. Choose a second star at least 20° away and at a different altitude.
guide.alignError: This pair doesn’t constrain the alignment well. Choose stars at different altitudes and directions, then retry.
guide.drift: The pointing may have drifted. Realign to a bright star.
guide.bullseye: Move the target dot toward the center
guide.eqHelp: Arrows refer to the RA/Dec axes. Knob rotation depends on your mount.
guide.azHelp: Right means clockwise when viewed from above.
guide.zenith: Near the zenith. Adjust altitude first.
guide.autoView: Show field chart when near target
guide.chartLimit: Position chart of stars through magnitude 9. It is not a photographic or brightness simulation. The thin cross marks the field center.
guide.chartAlt: Stars and target in a {{fov}} degree field
guide.previewNote: Drag the chart or use the arrows to explore. The tube direction and alignment stay unchanged.
guide.hopIntro: Move from a bright star, one step at a time. Your actual field is {{fov}}°. Directions use celestial north; the chart matches your finder orientation.
guide.noRoute: No reliable short route fits this field. Try a wider finder or binoculars, or choose a different target.
guide.hopBelow: Part of this route is below the horizon. Preview it now; confirm completion when the whole route is above the horizon.
guide.hopFinish: I found the target in the sky
guide.contextChart: A wider context chart. Use the equipment field stated above to judge each move.
guide.sunWarning: The target or pointing is too close to the Sun. Looking through a telescope or binoculars can seriously injure your eyes. Step away from the eyepiece and point the tube away from the Sun. Solar pointing is not supported.
guide.copyUnavailable: Copy is unavailable. Enter the displayed coordinates manually.
